periods.time: Same day as Bell's Guild report and Denatus
periods.label: Hestia updates Bell and defends his secrets at Denatus

status.denatus_role: First-time attendee because Bell reached Lv.2

appearance.overview: A small-bodied goddess with black twin tails who is affectionate and highly expressive around Bell.

attire.default: simple goddess outfit with twin-tail ribbons

personality.summary: Protective, affectionate, jealous, and proud; she wants Bell safe and recognized while keeping his dangerous growth secret.
fears: Bell looking to another woman first
desires: be the person Bell depends on
personality.inner_conflict: She wants to act like a dignified goddess, but Bell's kindness makes her emotionally vulnerable.

decision_pattern.protection: Conceals sensitive ability data, encourages Bell, and reacts intensely when she thinks he is hiding something.

quote_samples: 就算要我忍辱含垢，我发誓一定会夺回一个普通称号……！

mannerisms: runs in small hops to greet Bell
sits on Bell during status updates
smiles with distant divine tenderness when explaining Bell's skill
habits.daily_routine: Maintains Bell's Falna, works part-time, and handles household chores with Bell.
quirks: tries to recruit people even from her part-time job
becomes dramatically jealous when Bell appears to favor another woman

preferences.gifted_accessory: blue twin-tail ribbons with small silver bells

formative_events: Met Bell and formed Hestia Familia
Attends Denatus after Bell reaches Lv.2
background.pre_story: Recently descended and struggled to build a familia before meeting Bell.

possessions_owned: blue ribbon hair ornaments with silver bells

relationships.bell-cranel: First and only child at this stage; she becomes deeply attached and realizes she will fall in love with him.
relationships.miach: Friendly god who helps her learn familia registration procedures.
relationships.hephaestus: Close divine friend connected to Bell's eventual equipment path.
relationships.freya: Unknown rival whose interest in Bell worries the later Hestia.

knowledge: Knows Bell gained Heroic Desire / Argonaut
Knows Bell has Liaris Freese and keeps it hidden
Learns basic familia registration and rank rules from Miach in the flashback
secrets: Conceals Bell's Liaris Freese from Bell and the gods.
periods.summary: In the Denatus present, Hestia updates Bell and protects his secrets. In the flashback, she struggles financially as a new goddess, learns to register Hestia Familia, misunderstands Bell's secretive money-saving as interest in Eina, then discovers he worked himself ragged to buy her blue ribbon bells and realizes she will fall in love with him.

key_events.summary: Hestia updates Bell to Lv.2 and shows him Heroic Desire / Argonaut.
Bell gives Hestia blue ribbons with silver bells, resolving her jealousy and deepening their bond.
